installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SPT/Fika Dedicated (Headless) Client
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
cd ${HOME}

echo -e "${GREEN}Installing .NET SDK 9.0"
# Install wget if not present
apt-get update
apt-get install -y wget

# Download and install Microsoft package signing key
wget https://packages.microsoft.com/config/ubuntu/22.04/packages-microsoft-prod.deb -O packages-microsoft-prod.deb
dpkg -i packages-microsoft-prod.deb
rm packages-microsoft-prod.deb

# Install .NET SDK 9.0
apt-get update
apt-get install -y dotnet-sdk-9.0

# Verify dotnet installation and add to PATH
export PATH="$PATH:/usr/share/dotnet"
export DOTNET_ROOT=/usr/share/dotnet

# Check if dotnet is available
if ! command -v dotnet &> /dev/null; then
    echo -e "${RED}dotnet command not found after installation. Trying alternative paths..."
    
    # Try common dotnet installation paths
    if [ -f "/usr/bin/dotnet" ]; then
        export PATH="/usr/bin:$PATH"
    elif [ -f "/usr/share/dotnet/dotnet" ]; then
        export PATH="/usr/share/dotnet:$PATH"
    elif [ -f "/opt/dotnet/dotnet" ]; then
        export PATH="/opt/dotnet:$PATH"
        export DOTNET_ROOT=/opt/dotnet
    else
        echo -e "${RED}Could not find dotnet installation. Exiting."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Verify dotnet is now available
dotnet --version
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}dotnet is still not working. Exiting."
    exit 1
fi

echo -e "${GREEN}dotnet version: $(dotnet --version)"

# Add BepInEx NuGet source
dotnet nuget add source https://nuget.bepinex.dev/v3/index.json

# download and build the fika plugins
mkdir tmp
cd tmp

# build the fika plugin
echo -e "${GREEN}Building the fika plugin"
git clone https://github.com/project-fika/Fika-Plugin -b ${FIKA_PLUGIN_BRANCH}
cd Fika-Plugin
dotnet build --configuration Release
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}Failed to build Fika-Plugin"
    exit 1
fi
cd ${HOME}/tmp

# build the Fika-Headless 
echo -e "${GREEN}Building the Fika-Headless"
git clone https://github.com/project-fika/Fika-Headless -b ${FIKA_DEDICATED_BRANCH}
cd Fika-Headless
dotnet build --configuration Release
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}Failed to build Fika-Headless"
    exit 1
fi

# setup directories
cd ${HOME}
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Dedicated-Client/BepInEx/plugins
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.wine/drive_c/live

# registry files
echo -e "${GREEN}Importing custom registry files"
apt-get install -yq curl
cd /mnt/server/.wine
curl -o system.reg https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhliau/fika-headless-docker/22ea3d450010f44edcae3efec6f671040b9d98c5/data/reg/system.reg
curl -o user.reg https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhliau/fika-headless-docker/22ea3d450010f44edcae3efec6f671040b9d98c5/data/reg/user.reg
echo -e "${GREEN}Imported custom registry files"

cd ${HOME}

# Create pre-check script
cat > /mnt/server/pre-check.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
RED="\033[0;31m" 
if [ ! -f ./.wine/drive_c/live/ConsistencyInfo ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}The live EFT files are not present, put them in /home/container/.wine/drive_c/live (EscapeFromTarkov_Data is not required)"
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f ./Dedicated-Client/EscapeFromTarkov.exe ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}The SPT Files are not present, put them in /home/container/Dedicated-Client"
    exit 1
fi
EOF
chmod +x /mnt/server/pre-check.sh

# Copy built DLLs - Check for both net471 and netstandard2.1
echo -e "${GREEN}Copying built plugins"

# Find Fika.Core.dll
FIKA_CORE_DLL=""
if [ -f "${HOME}/tmp/Fika-Plugin/Fika.Core/bin/Release/net471/Fika.Core.dll" ]; then
    FIKA_CORE_DLL="${HOME}/tmp/Fika-Plugin/Fika.Core/bin/Release/net471/Fika.Core.dll"
elif [ -f "${HOME}/tmp/Fika-Plugin/Fika.Core/bin/Release/netstandard2.1/Fika.Core.dll" ]; then
    FIKA_CORE_DLL="${HOME}/tmp/Fika-Plugin/Fika.Core/bin/Release/netstandard2.1/Fika.Core.dll"
fi

if [ -n "$FIKA_CORE_DLL" ] && [ -f "$FIKA_CORE_DLL" ]; then
    cp "$FIKA_CORE_DLL" /mnt/server/Dedicated-Client/BepInEx/plugins/
    echo -e "${GREEN}Fika.Core.dll copied successfully from: $FIKA_CORE_DLL"
else
    echo -e "${RED}Fika.Core.dll not found in any expected location"
    echo -e "${RED}Checking available files:"
    find ${HOME}/tmp/Fika-Plugin -name "Fika.Core.dll" 2>/dev/null
fi

# Find Fika.Headless.dll
FIKA_HEADLESS_DLL=""
if [ -f "${HOME}/tmp/Fika-Headless/Fika.Headless/bin/Release/net471/Fika.Headless.dll" ]; then
    FIKA_HEADLESS_DLL="${HOME}/tmp/Fika-Headless/Fika.Headless/bin/Release/net471/Fika.Headless.dll"
elif [ -f "${HOME}/tmp/Fika-Headless/Fika.Headless/bin/Release/netstandard2.1/Fika.Headless.dll" ]; then
    FIKA_HEADLESS_DLL="${HOME}/tmp/Fika-Headless/Fika.Headless/bin/Release/netstandard2.1/Fika.Headless.dll"
fi

if [ -n "$FIKA_HEADLESS_DLL" ] && [ -f "$FIKA_HEADLESS_DLL" ]; then
    cp "$FIKA_HEADLESS_DLL" /mnt/server/Dedicated-Client/BepInEx/plugins/
    echo -e "${GREEN}Fika.Headless.dll copied successfully from: $FIKA_HEADLESS_DLL"
else
    echo -e "${RED}Fika.Headless.dll not found in any expected location"
    echo -e "${RED}Checking available files:"
    find ${HOME}/tmp/Fika-Headless -name "Fika.Headless.dll" 2>/dev/null
fi

# Cleanup
echo -e "${GREEN}Cleaning up temporary files"
cd ${HOME}
rm -rf tmp

echo -e "${GREEN}Install complete!"
